open_questions: Demographics: median age, median household income, and owner-occupancy % for ZIP 33444 could not be verified on a page read (Census Reporter page returned only population/density). Search snippets suggested median household income ~$72,869-$74,803 and median age ~41.3 (censuseasy.com, areazine.com, palavir.co, ACS 2023 5-yr) but those pages were not read; treat as unverified.

Proximity: no verified distances to nearest hospital, library, school, or grocery. A homes.com listing snippet (page returned Access Denied) claimed Lynn University is 8.2 miles / 17 minutes away and Wakodahatchee Wetlands preserve is ~1.5 miles away; unverified.

Fees: hoa-agent.com shows a single resident-verified data point of $1,024.66/mo; search snippets from hoa-community.com and mycleancondo.com suggested a $700-$1,073/mo range (and homes.com snippet $700-$800/mo, $620-$668 with capital contribution) but those figures were not visible on pages read. Confirm current dues with the HOA.
CDD/special assessments: hoa-agent.com reports 'no assessment signals' for this community; no CDD assessment amount found.
Management company: hoa-agent.com lists Campbell Property Management; unit count unknown (hoa-agent.com).
Pet/rental rules: hoa-agent.com reports pet breed restrictions and rental application/buyer approval required; not independently verified.
Data year for the Census Reporter population figure was not displayed on the page read (likely recent ACS 5-year estimates).
